paragraphs: Menachem of Gufta Aryeh. See the entry Pinchas ben Guvta de-Ariach.

notes.text: The elements Gufta Aryeh and Guvta de-Ariach remain opaque. The frozen text gives איש in the first designation and בן in the target; no conjectural correction or location identification is adopted.

The saved named Guggenheimer Sanhedrin 10:2 paragraph tells a Peor story of Menachem of Gufta Ariach. The saved local V42 Pinchas ben Guvta de-Ariach notice tells a parallel story attributed by Hyman to ספרא בלק. That local text is Hyman’s report, not a separately inspected Sifrei witness. The full cross-reference and the distinct איש/בן and name forms remain without identity or location binding.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 890, confirms the complete pointer מנחם איש גופתה אריה. ערך פנחס בן גובתה דאריח, including בן as part of the entry referred to. The consulted Yerushalmi Sanhedrin 10:2 instead names Menachem איש גופתה אריח in the Peor story. The separate Hyman notice names Pinchas בן גובתא דאריח and attributes a parallel story to ספרא בלק; that notice is not an independent inspection of the work it cites. The English retains the frozen forms, and the different names, איש/בן, and spellings do not establish a place or personal identity.
